_about: Answers to decision questions from grading reports. Append new entries; never edit old ones. The newest answer to a question wins.

decisions.question: Approve rescheduling a job's next run even when it raises, so a failing job retries at its next interval instead of on every tick?
decisions.answer: Yes, and log the exception at WARNING before re-raising.
